# Cursor Changelog — captured 2026-07-03

## Jun 29-30, 2026 [NEW — crosses watching-tier bar]
- **Cursor Mobile App for iOS (Jun 29)**: new agent surface. Launch and manage always-on/cloud agents from a phone, with voice input; "Remote Control" to direct desktop agents from the phone. Entirely new control plane for triggering agent runs off-device.
- **MCPs and Organizations in Team Marketplaces (Jun 30)**: teams can distribute/install MCP servers across cloud agents, IDE, and CLI via marketplace configs, with Organization group access controls. New MCP distribution surface at org scale.

## Jun 17-18, 2026 [NEW — crosses watching-tier bar]
- **Cloud Environment Setup and Cloud Subagents in Agents Window (Jun 17)**: `/in-cloud` command spawns cloud subagents for isolated parallel work; automated cloud environment setup with reusable snapshots. New cloud agent-execution surface.
- **Improvements to Cursor Automations (Jun 18)**: `/automate` skill to create automations inside an agent session; computer-use capability for automations (produce demos/artifacts); five new GitHub triggers (issue comments, PR review comments, workflow completion, etc.) and a Slack emoji-reaction trigger. New automation triggers + computer-use = expanded autonomous tool-execution surface.

## Jun 22, 2026 [below bar]
- "Customize Cursor" — personalization/UI. Not a new capability.

## June 10, 2026 [cached, below bar]
- Bugbot Performance Improvements — 3x faster (~90s), 10% more bugs, 22% cheaper. Perf/cost.

## June 5, 2026 (Version 3.7) [cached]
- Design Mode (multi-select in browser, voice narration, canvas Design Mode; agents embed interactive buttons in canvases).
- SDK (TS & Python): custom tools via `local.customTools` (no separate MCP server); auto-review classifier gates tool execution via permissions.json; JSONL/custom stores; nested subagents at any depth.
- Canvas: interactive context-usage reports.
- Enterprise: Organizations (multi-team, separate security/budget), Groups.
- Bugbot `/review` pre-push; incremental reviews.

## Earlier (cached): 3.6 Auto-review Run Mode; 3.5 Shared Canvases / /loop Skill / Cursor Automations; Cursor in Jira; 3.4 Dev Environments for Cloud Agents; Cursor in MS Teams; Build in Parallel /multitask.

Docs sections (cursor.com/docs): Agents, Rules, MCP, Skills, CLI.

Updated: 2026-07-03 — Watching tier. NEW major surfaces since 06-16 cache: iOS mobile agent app + Remote Control (06-29), team/org MCP marketplace distribution (06-30), cloud subagents via /in-cloud (06-17), computer-use in Automations + new GitHub/Slack triggers (06-18). Reported.
